attempts.why: Change dialog article descendant selector to child selector so nested card inside modal does not inherit modal container styles.

selfVerify.reason: Nested #inner card inside modal no longer matches dialog article selector - inner article renders as normal card with its own shadow/border inside modal body, not inheriting modal container positioning/box-shadow/borders/spacing from dialog>article.

pick.suspected: Modal uses `dialog article` descendant selector instead of `dialog > article`, so nested #inner article card inside the modal incorrectly inherits modal container styles (extra box-shadow/borders/spacing/positioning).
